BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; UNITED HEROES LEAGUE. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to veterans; requiring a report; appropriating money for a grant to the United Heroes League.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; UNITED HEROES LEAGUE.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs to provide a grant to the United Heroes League, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. The grant recipient must use the grant money to make capital improvements to the organization's campus in Hastings, Minnesota, that will directly benefit current service members, veterans, and their dependents. By January 15, 2027, the commissioner of veterans affairs must report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over veterans regarding the uses of grant money, including any amount used for grant administration. The report must be filed with the Legislative Reference Library in compliance with Minnesota Statutes, section 3.195. As a condition of receiving the grant, United Heroes League must agree to provide the commissioner of veterans affairs any information needed to complete the report.

As a condition of receiving the grant, United Heroes League must agree to provide the commissioner of veterans affairs any information needed to complete the report.
